first_turn_candidate: FIXED_CANDIDATE; deterministic lifecycle setup, excluded from live performance statistics
collection: Serial fixed order; A at current-primary provider stage, B at later prior-reply provider stage; capture authoritative S before B. Stop truthfully on infrastructure/provider/authority failure; no replacement samples or prompt tuning.
isolation: Both comparison paths are separately JSON-reconstructed and authority-restored copies of S; assert exact pre-state equality. Capture primary runtime authority read-only through the existing TS-private instance property, not snapshot() which flushes work. No live subject files.
comparison: Actual independent calls remain on baseline. Replay B in CONTROL and seven model fields of A in SHADOW through original product adapter and real authorities. No field/value normalization for CONTROL versus SHADOW other than sorted object keys.
request_gate: All intended pairs must match actual complete request plus frozen observed provider/model configuration; any mismatch forbids that pair. Hash and full normalized identity must both agree.
authority_gate: All deterministic failure controls and independent authority/admission/order checks must pass. Any unaccounted authority or identity bypass rejects reuse.
behavior_gate: Zero candidate/canonical/projection divergence supports LOW RISK only within this bounded sample. A valid candidate divergence propagated to canonical Affect or future cognition is material evidence against treating reuse as equivalent. Report every difference; do not tune rate thresholds after observation. Failures or inadequate eligible pairs yield UNKNOWN.
performance_gate: Report measured B latency and actual Ollama token counts, including warm/cold loading. Judge practical local value against one-slot complexity, without universal numerical cutoff. Full-turn contribution uses separately labeled historical estimate only.

samples.text: The train arrives at noon, and I have already packed my bag.
Thank you for listening yesterday. I felt understood, and that helped me.
You ignored what I said and repeated the same advice. I am frustrated with you.
Could you help me decide which question to ask at tomorrow's meeting?
Well, that was unexpected. I am still not sure what to make of it.
I just learned that my closest friend is moving far away next week. I feel overwhelmed.
Alice told me she would call tonight, but she has not replied to my last two messages.
I got the position I worked toward for months. I wanted to share the good news with you.
The meeting was postponed again. I do not know whether my plans for Friday still make sense.
